summary.text: Craig Fishbein has represented Connecticut's 90th House District since November 2016 and is the Republican candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: He graduated from Mark T. Sheehan High School in Wallingford in 1983, earned a marketing degree from Quinnipiac University and graduated from Quinnipiac University School of Law in 2001.
He joined his father at Fishbein Law Firm in Wallingford, served on the Wallingford Town Council beginning in 2010, and was appointed in 2012 to the state Board of Firearms Permit Examiners.
